marks.gloss_en: ת"ש, רבי יוסי אומר... בששי לא היה לו פנאי -- מאי לאו משום תורה? (the Torah was given on the sixth)

R' Yosei: on the 2nd [of Sivan] Moses ascended and descended, on the 3rd ascended and descended, [as the stam emends the 4th: ומאחר שלא עלה מהיכן ירד? אלא] on the 4th ascended and descended, on the 5th built an altar and offered on it, on the 6th he had no leisure
לא, משום טורח שבת -- he had no leisure because of the burden of [preparing for] Shabbat
the Galilean, before Rav Chisda: blessed is the Merciful who gave a threefold Torah, to a threefold people, by a third-born, on the third day, in the third month
לרבנן שמונה חסרים עבוד -- that year eight months were made deficient
15 Nisan was Friday, so 1 Nisan Friday, Iyar Sunday, Sivan Monday -- against R' Yosei's Sunday
אמר לך רבי יוסי: הא מני -- רבנן היא (= p_seder_olam_kerabbanan)
Seder Olam: in the Nisan of the Exodus they slaughtered on the 14th, left on the 15th, and that day was Shabbat eve
מכאן -- from the mountain overturned over them like a tub
דכתיב קימו וקבלו היהודים -- קיימו מה שקיבלו כבר
Rav Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa: 'and they stood at the foot (lit. underneath) of the mountain' (Ex 19:17) teaches that the Holy One overturned the mountain over them like a tub
כדריש לקיש -- the extra heh of 'the sixth day': creation's endurance was conditioned on Israel's accepting the Torah
Chizkiya: 'from heaven You made judgment heard, the earth feared and was still' (Ps 76:9) -- if it feared, why still; if still, why did it fear? rather: at first it feared and in the end it was still
'and the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments' (Ex 33:6) is juxtaposed to 'and Moses would take the tent' (Ex 33:7): the crowns Israel lost, Moses took
שנאמר ויתנצלו בני ישראל את עדים מהר חורב
בחורב טענו -- כדאמרן: the crowns tied on when they put 'we will do' before 'we will hear'
בחורב פרקו -- דכתיב ויתנצלו בני ישראל את עדים מהר חורב
שנאמר ופדויי ה' ישבון... ושמחת עולם על ראשם -- שמחה שמעולם על ראשם
R' Simai: when Israel put 'we will do' before 'we will hear', 600,000 ministering angels came and tied two crowns on each of Israel, one for 'we will do' and one for 'we will hear'
דכתיב עשי דברו לשמע בקול דברו -- ברישא עושי והדר לשמוע
when Israel put 'we will do' before 'we will hear', a bat kol went out and said to them: who revealed to My children this secret that the ministering angels use?
a heretic saw Rava absorbed in study, his fingers under his leg, pressing them, and his fingers were spurting blood
